ينجبر (form VII)
# يَنْجَبِرُ (yanjabiru) /jan.d͡ʒa.bi.ru/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْجَبَرَ (injabara)
# يَنْجَبِرَ (yanjabira) /jan.d͡ʒa.bi.ra/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْجَبَرَ (injabara)
# يَنْجَبِرْ (yanjabir) /jan.d͡ʒa.bir/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِنْجَبَرَ (injabara)
